details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 3, Skirmisher

The Keepers think you are a scout. The Veiled Ones think you are their eyes on the frontier. Both are paying you, and you would like to keep it that way. You notice things, write them down, and pass them on.

Tonight: The innkeeper keeps a locked door behind the bar, and he checks it every hour.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Sneak Attack. Once a round, against an aware but unsuspecting target within 30ft (it can't see you, hasn't acted yet this fight, or is in melee with an ally and not you): Advantage on the attack and +2d6 damage (1d6 Rogue, +1d6 Predator). Cannot combine with Back Attack.

Back Attack. Once a round, after a successful Hide or Move Silently check, attacking from behind with a melee weapon shorter than your arm: Advantage and the weapon's dice are doubled (short sword 2d6+4).

Rogue Skills. Climb (Dex), Decipher Script (Int), Open Locks (Dex, one try per lock per level; Advantage with your lockpicks), Pick Pocket (Dex, DC 10 + target's Level), Find, Disable or Set Trap (Int). Thieves' Cant.

Hide and Move Silently. Normal roll at half speed or less, Disadvantage above it. You can Hide while only lightly obscured. Both at once: Disadvantage on both, quarter speed.

Cunning Step. Once a round, move away from a creature in your reach without provoking.

Alertness (feat, 1st). You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 initiative (included).

Predator (feat, 2nd). Advantage on Stealth checks, and your Sneak Attack deals +1d6 (included).

Kit: The Veiled Ones. Silent Tail: Advantage to observe or tail someone unseen; a creature you watched for 10 minutes before a fight has Disadvantage on its attacks against you in the first round. Discreet Channels: Advantage on checks to gather, verify or pass on information quietly, or to explain why you're somewhere you shouldn't be.

Halfling. Move through the space of any larger creature. Advantage on farming, foraging and plant identification.

Armour Class on the sheet: Leather armour +2, Dex +3. Leather is Insulated: Resistance 5 to cold

Class Abilities

1st Level

  • Cant — a coded thieves' language
  • Climb (Dexterity)
  • Decipher Script (Intelligence): 2d8 minutes per page; arcane script is a Hard check to read (you cannot cast it); never works on divine scrolls
  • Open Locks (Dexterity): one attempt per lock until you gain a level
  • Pick Pocket (Dexterity): DC 10 + the target's Level
  • Find/Disable/Set Trap (Intelligence)

Back Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a damage multiplier (double at 1st level, rising to sextuple at 20th — see the Rogue Progression Table). Usable once per round. Requires a successful Move Silently or Hide check, attacking from behind a target with a discernible back, using a close-quarters melee weapon shorter than your arm. Multiply the weapon's damage dice only.

Sneak Attack

  • Effect: Advantage on the attack roll plus a scaling damage die (1d6 at 1st level, rising to 4d6 at 23rd — see the Rogue Progression Table) against an aware-but-unsuspecting target, once per round. Usable at range within 30ft, doesn't require a prior stealth check, can't combine with Back Attack. A target is unsuspecting if it cannot see you, has not yet acted this encounter, or is in melee with one of your allies and not with you.

Precise Strikes

  • Effect: Your weapon attacks deal +1 damage per three Rogue levels (minimum +1). This applies to every hit, not only Sneak Attacks.

Hide and Move Silently

  • Effect: Normal roll at half speed or under, disadvantage above half speed, impossible to attempt while running or charging. You may Hide while only lightly obscured.
  • Listen: disadvantage when listening through any solid barrier

2nd Level

Cunning Step

  • Effect: Once per round, you may move away from a creature in melee reach without provoking opportunity attacks.

3rd Level

  • Attempting Hide and Move Silently together imposes Disadvantage on both checks, at quarter speed

5th Level

Uncanny Dodge

  • Effect: Once per round, when an attacker you can see hits you, halve the damage.

7th Level

Evasion

  • Effect: When you succeed on a Reflex save against an effect that deals half damage on a success, you take none. If you fail, you take half.

Extra Attack

  • Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex). Sneak Attack still applies to only one attack per round.

11th Level

Skill Mastery

  • Effect: Treat any d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10 when using your Rogue Skills.

14th Level

  • Sixth Sense: +1 to surprise checks (scales to +2 at 18th, +3 at 22nd)

15th Level

Detect Secret/Concealed Doors

  • Effect: Advantage on checks to find secret or concealed doors, plus a free check whenever you pass within 10ft of one.
  • Dexterity Bonus: permanent +1 Dexterity

17th Level

  • The disadvantage from moving fast while hiding or moving silently is removed entirely

18th Level

  • Quick Reaction: +1 to initiative

20th Level

Evasive Manoeuvre

  • Effect: +4 AC in melee. Cannot combine with ranged attacks or other rogue abilities that round, and cannot be used if surprised.

24th Level

  • Hide and Move Silently are fully unpenalised even while running or charging

Quick Reaction (Improved)

  • Effect: +2 to initiative. Once per encounter, take one extra action in the first round — one additional attack or half movement.

Kits — Arneyan Thief Cultures

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Rogue folder. Drag one onto your character.

Rogue Kits represent the network, upbringing, or tradition that shaped the character's criminal trade.

• An operative working the outer ring of the Veiled Ones' growing intelligence network — not a full member, but trained and trusted enough to collect, verify, and pass on information. The Veiled Ones work for The Violet Conclave and are building this network deliberately, using ysoki gatherers and trained agents like you. Your identity is protected; most of what you know about the organisation above you is limited by design.

system.description:
Nothing gets past you unnoticed — not the shift in a shadow, not the change in someone's breathing before they act. You're already moving before most people even register something's wrong. Cannot be surprised by nonmagical means; gain +2 to Initiative rolls. This stacks with Advantage on Initiative from other sources (such as Swift Reflexes or the Swashbuckler's En Garde).

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.

You move like something that's done this before — silent, low, patient. And if the strike lands from where they never saw you coming, it lands harder for it. Gain Advantage on Stealth checks. If you have the Sneak Attack ability, your Sneak Attack deals +1d6.

Available to: Rogues, Assassins, Rangers, Monks, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, and Artificers.
